research_question: Can Neuro3D compute coherent fields from actual captured Blender geometry using a native ray backend, with sound and useful error certificates for every complete scene in a prospectively frozen evaluation family, while explicitly rejecting uncertifiable cases?
primary_hypothesis: Every CERTIFIED output contains the exact field of the admitted represented scalar model; intensity and decision bounds follow from that field interval and all relevant nonzero paths are accounted for or bounded.
primary_refutation: One independently verified CERTIFIED interval excluding the exact represented truth, an incompatible certified decision, or an unbounded nonzero omitted path declared complete refutes soundness.
nonvacuity_gate: All prospectively frozen complete fixtures must return useful certificates; universal UNKNOWN is not success. Analytic, adverse, negative and captured full Iris cases required.
